{
  "dataset_name": "spambase",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "spam_word_composite_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted sum of high-spam-indicator word frequencies (money, free, business, credit-related terms) normalized by log1p transform for smooth SVM margins",
      "formula": "np.log1p(word_freq_24 + word_freq_25 + word_freq_26 + word_freq_44 + word_freq_45 + word_freq_41 + word_freq_20)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.5],
      "feature_family": "word_frequency_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates multiple spam-indicative word signals into a single smooth continuous score, reducing dimensionality and providing a strong linear separator",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "capital_run_severity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-normalized composite of capital letter run statistics capturing aggressive capitalization patterns common in spam",
      "formula": "np.log1p(capital_run_length_average) * 0.4 + np.log1p(capital_run_length_longest) * 0.35 + np.log1p(capital_run_length_total) * 0.25",
      "value_range": [0.0, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "capital_run_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Combines three capital run metrics into a smooth severity score that linearly separates aggressive capitalization patterns",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "special_char_spam_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted combination of special character frequencies associated with spam (exclamation marks, dollar signs, hash) with log smoothing",
      "formula": "np.log1p(char_freq_3 * 2.0 + char_freq_4 * 1.5 + char_freq_5 * 1.0 + char_freq_1 * 0.5)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "char_frequency_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures punctuation-based spam signals in a single smooth feature suitable for linear SVM decision boundaries",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "capital_run_length_log_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log ratio of longest capital run to average capital run length, capturing burstiness of capitalization",
      "formula": "np.log1p(capital_run_length_longest) / (np.log1p(capital_run_length_average) + 0.001)",
      "value_range": [0.5, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "capital_run_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Measures how bursty vs uniform capitalization is, providing a ratio feature that works well with linear margins",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "total_word_activity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of all word frequencies across all 48 word features, log-transformed to capture overall email verbosity",
      "formula": "np.log1p(word_freq_0 + word_freq_1 + word_freq_2 + word_freq_3 + word_freq_4 + word_freq_5 + word_freq_6 + word_freq_7 + word_freq_8 + word_freq_9 + word_freq_10 + word_freq_11 + word_freq_12 + word_freq_13 + word_freq_14 + word_freq_15 + word_freq_16 + word_freq_17 + word_freq_18 + word_freq_19 + word_freq_20 + word_freq_21 + word_freq_22 + word_freq_23 + word_freq_24 + word_freq_25 + word_freq_26 + word_freq_27 + word_freq_28 + word_freq_29 + word_freq_30 + word_freq_31 + word_freq_32 + word_freq_33 + word_freq_34 + word_freq_35 + word_freq_36 + word_freq_37 + word_freq_38 + word_freq_39 + word_freq_40 + word_freq_41 + word_freq_42 + word_freq_43 + word_freq_44 + word_freq_45 + word_freq_46 + word_freq_47)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.5],
      "feature_family": "word_frequency_aggregate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a global measure of word frequency density that can help linear SVM distinguish high-activity spam from normal emails",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "char_freq_total_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-normalized sum of all character frequency features capturing overall special character density",
      "formula": "np.log1p(char_freq_0 + char_freq_1 + char_freq_2 + char_freq_3 + char_freq_4 + char_freq_5)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "char_frequency_aggregate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates all special character signals into a smooth continuous feature for linear separation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "high_freq_word_concentration",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of top spam word frequencies to total word activity, measuring concentration of spam-indicative terms",
      "formula": "(word_freq_18 + word_freq_20 + word_freq_11 + word_freq_24) / (word_freq_0 + word_freq_1 + word_freq_2 + word_freq_4 + word_freq_5 + word_freq_9 + word_freq_11 + word_freq_15 + word_freq_17 + word_freq_18 + word_freq_20 + word_freq_24 + word_freq_25 + word_freq_26 + 0.01)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "word_frequency_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ratio feature capturing how concentrated spam-indicative words are relative to common words, useful for linear SVM margins",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "capital_run_total_log_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-normalized total capital run length scaled by training set mean to create a deviation score",
      "formula": "np.log1p(capital_run_length_total) / np.log1p(276.93)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.8],
      "feature_family": "capital_run_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a normalized continuous score of capital letter usage relative to typical email, suitable for linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "exclamation_dollar_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Multiplicative interaction between exclamation mark frequency and dollar sign frequency, capturing co-occurrence of aggressive punctuation",
      "formula": "np.log1p(char_freq_3 * char_freq_4)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.5],
      "feature_family": "char_frequency_interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures non-linear interaction between two key spam punctuation signals in a log-linearized form suitable for linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "rare_word_spam_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of low-mean but high-variance word frequencies that tend to appear in spam contexts, log-smoothed",
      "formula": "np.log1p(word_freq_3 + word_freq_21 + word_freq_37 + word_freq_46 + word_freq_47 + word_freq_40)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.5],
      "feature_family": "rare_word_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures presence of unusual words that rarely appear in legitimate emails, providing discriminative signal for linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "word_diversity_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of how many distinct word frequency features are non-zero, normalized to [0,1]. Higher values indicate broader vocabulary usage typical of legitimate emails, while very low values with high total frequency suggest repetitive spam patterns. Score is estimated as proportion of non-zero word features weighted by their relative magnitudes.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "vocabulary_diversity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth diversity measure that helps linear SVM distinguish repetitive spam from diverse legitimate communication",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "aggressive_formatting_index",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite index combining capital run severity with special character density to measure overall aggressive formatting intensity",
      "formula": "np.clip((np.log1p(capital_run_length_average) * 0.3 + np.log1p(capital_run_length_longest) * 0.2 + char_freq_3 * 0.3 + char_freq_4 * 0.2) / 5.0, 0.0, 1.0)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "formatting_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Single normalized score capturing aggressive formatting patterns across both capitalization and punctuation dimensions, ideal for linear SVM decision boundary",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
